title: ProjectHost domain edge map
description: Maps vault YAML relations to Graphify EXTRACTED edges. Graphify semantic `relation` is a closed enum; domain names stay in YAML. Overlay (later) emits confidence EXTRACTED / confidence_score 1.0. Human copy: docs/00-project/EDGES.md.

node_ids.notes: Graphify stem from vault-relative path (e.g. docs/00-project/GOAL.md → docs_00_project_goal).
node_ids.code: Graphify AST ids for PHP / Vue / SCSS under app/ and api/.
node_ids.glossary_god_nodes: Human wikilink [[term]] (filename unique across the vault).

rules: If a process relation is not in YAML (or @spec / @glossary in code), it is not a process edge (INFERRED at best).
A body wikilink without a matching YAML field is Graphify references EXTRACTED (citation), not a domain relation.
Direction: source = note or file that declares the field, except IMPLEMENTS (code → spec).
Do not invent Graphify relation values outside graphify_relations.

edges.source: prev wiki-link target note, then current note
edges.target: current note, then next wiki-link target note
the spec or task note that declares governed_by

edges.source: code file (PHP, Vue/Nuxt, SCSS under app/)
test note and files in test_paths / code_paths

edges.target: Vue SFC / SCSS listed in code_paths under app/
glossary/* notes linked from the summary body and glossary field
